sn22.20:1.1: Sāvatthi || || Tatra || voca || || Rūpam bhikkhave ānattā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo rūpassa uppādāya so pi anattā || anattasambhūtam bhikkhave rūpam kuto attā bhavissati || || Vedanā anattā || Saññā anattā || Saṅkhārā anattā || Viññāṇam anattā || yo pi hetu yo pi paccayo viññāṇassa uppādāya so pi anattā || anattasambhūtam bhikkhave viññāṇaṃ kuto attā bhavissati || || Evam passaṃ || la || nāparam itthattāyāti pajānātīti || ||
